published_ranges._ams: Compatible with BambuLab AMS (new spool system)
published_ranges._notes: ESD: volume resistivity 10^5-10^7 ohm*cm, surface resistivity 10^5-10^8 ohm. Filament surface is not smooth (nanoparticles). Raise temperature if the nozzle clogs. Bed: smooth PEI + adhesive, textured PEI, glass + adhesive.

conflicts: _enclosure: does not require a heated chamber (source: marketing description on https://fiberlogy.com/en/filaments/petg-en/petg-esd-en/)
